quotes.text: Someone asked me once if I had any regrets and I said yeah, I regret every relationship I had in my thirties because I was an absolute catastrophic arsehole to be around and somehow women kept showing up anyway. God bless 'em. Terrible taste, the lot of them. Present company excepted, darling.
